 PVL: Brooke, MJ lift Chameleons over Eya, Sisi-led Flying Titans for 4-0 
 By Nicole Anne D.G. Bugauisan
 November 3, 2026
 30
 Resize 
 Small 
 Medium 
 Large 
 MANILA, Philippines — The Nxled Chameleons overcame a second-set hiccup against the Choco Mucho Flying Titans, 25-23, 23-25, 25-23, 25-17 to remain unscathed in the 2026-27 Premier Volleyball League (PVL) All-Filipino Conference-Siklab Series on Tuesday night at the Smart Araneta Coliseum in Cubao, Quezon City.
 The Chameleons are tied with defending champions Creamline Cool Smashers at the top of the standings with a 4-0 record, while Choco Mucho tallied a 3-2 card.
 Brooke Van Sickle starred in Chameleon’s win after an all-around performance of 19 points, 12 excellent digs, and 10 excellent receptions.
 If Choco Mucho has a famous duo of Eya Laure and Sisi Rondina-Rosales, Nxled’s Van Sickle and MJ Phillips also proved to be a lethal pair.
 While Van Sickle led the scoring for the Chameleons with 19 points, Phillips made 13 points on 10 attacks and three blocks, while Myla Pablo added 12 points for the team’s win.
